anomalies.message: High CPU load averages (9.6, 10.25, 11.06) on an 8-core system indicate potential overutilization.
No recent learning cycles or AI adjustments, which may indicate a lack of AI-driven trading activity or issues with the AI module.
Zero active trades and zero total profit/loss suggest a potential issue with trading activity or strategy effectiveness.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load and improve system performance.
Review and potentially update AI models or strategies to ensure they are actively generating opportunities and making adjustments.

recommendations.action: Conduct a detailed analysis of CPU usage to identify and address processes causing high load.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, impacting trading operations.

recommendations.action: Evaluate the effectiveness of current trading strategies and AI models to ensure they are functioning as intended.
recommendations.rationale: Zero active trades and AI inactivity may indicate issues with strategy execution or AI model performance.

recommendations.action: Perform a system health check to ensure all components are functioning correctly and efficiently.
recommendations.rationale: Regular health checks can prevent unexpected downtime and ensure optimal system performance.
